instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng

questions.question: How is productivity expressed with LOC?
options: lines per person-month
persons per line here here
lines per module now
modules per month too
options_ar: أسطر لكل شهر عمل شخصي أيضاً
أسطر لكل وحدة الآن هنا مجدداً
options_en: lines per person-month
persons per line here here
lines per module now
modules per month too
questions.explanation: Productivity is output per unit of effort, so LOC divided by person-months.
questions.explanation_ar: الإنتاجية مخرَج لكل وحدة جهد، أي الأسطر مقسومة على أشهر العمل.

questions.question: How is productivity expressed with function points?
options: points per test here too here
function points per person-month
persons per function point now
points per module now again too here
options_ar: نقاط وظائف لكل شهر عمل شخصي
نقاط لكل وحدة هنا أيضاً الآن
options_en: points per test here too here
function points per person-month
persons per function point now
points per module now again too here
questions.explanation: FP per person-month is the language-independent productivity rate.
questions.explanation_ar: نقاط الوظائف لكل شهر عمل هي معدل الإنتاجية المستقل عن اللغة.

questions.question: What does effort distribution across phases show?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يبيّن توزيع الجهد على المراحل؟
options: which compiler was used here
the release date here too now here
where the effort actually goes
who wrote the code now again
options_ar: تاريخ الإصدار الآن هنا مجدداً هنا
أين يذهب الجهد فعلاً الآن الآن
من كتب الكود هنا أيضاً أيضاً
options_en: which compiler was used here
the release date here too now here
where the effort actually goes
who wrote the code now again
questions.explanation: The split across requirements, design, code, test and maintenance exposes imbalance.
questions.explanation_ar: التوزيع على المتطلبات والتصميم والترميز والاختبار والصيانة يكشف الخلل.

questions.question: What is rework in process terms?
questions.question_ar: ما هي إعادة العمل بمصطلحات العملية؟
options: effort spent on new features too
effort spent in meetings here here here
effort spent on training now again
effort spent correcting earlier work
options_ar: جهد على خصائص جديدة أيضاً الآن
جهد يُصرف على تصحيح عمل سابق
options_en: effort spent on new features too
effort spent in meetings here here here
effort spent on training now again
effort spent correcting earlier work
questions.explanation: Rework is the cost of not getting it right the first time.
questions.explanation_ar: إعادة العمل هي كلفة عدم الإنجاز الصحيح من المرة الأولى.

questions.question: What does cost of quality combine?
options: prevention, appraisal and failure costs
salaries and rent here again too now
hardware and software too now here too here
training and travel now here again
options_en: prevention, appraisal and failure costs
salaries and rent here again too now
hardware and software too now here too here
training and travel now here again
questions.explanation: Quality cost covers what you spend to prevent defects plus what they cost when they escape.
questions.explanation_ar: كلفة الجودة تغطي ما يُصرف لمنع العيوب زائد كلفتها عند إفلاتها.

questions.question: What do process maturity metrics track?
options: how many users log in now again again too
how disciplined and repeatable the process is
how fast the compiler runs here too now
how many lines exist here too now here again here
options_ar: سرعة المترجم الآن هنا أيضاً الآن
عدد الأسطر هنا أيضاً الآن هنا مجدداً
options_en: how many users log in now again again too
how disciplined and repeatable the process is
how fast the compiler runs here too now
how many lines exist here too now here again here
questions.explanation: Maturity measures how reliably an organisation repeats a defined process.
questions.explanation_ar: النضج يقيس موثوقية تكرار المنظمة لعملية معرّفة.

questions.question: What is a baseline in a metrics programme?
questions.question_ar: ما هو خط الأساس في برنامج قياس؟
options: the final release here again too now
the project charter now here again too
a recorded reference value for comparison
the first line of code too now here again
options_ar: أول سطر كود هنا أيضاً الآن
options_en: the final release here again too now
the project charter now here again too
a recorded reference value for comparison
the first line of code too now here again
questions.explanation: Without a baseline you cannot say whether a change improved anything.
questions.explanation_ar: بلا خط أساس لا يمكن القول إن تغييراً حسّن شيئاً.

questions.question: Why does productivity need a size measure?
options: effort is not measurable now here
the team size is unknown too
the schedule is fixed here again
output has to be counted somehow
options_ar: الجهد غير قابل للقياس هنا أيضاً
المخرَج يجب أن يُعدّ بطريقة ما
options_en: effort is not measurable now here
the team size is unknown too
the schedule is fixed here again
output has to be counted somehow
questions.explanation: Productivity is output over effort, so an unmeasured output makes the ratio meaningless.
questions.explanation_ar: الإنتاجية مخرَج على جهد، ومخرَج غير مقيس يجعل النسبة بلا معنى.
